summary: Order total applies a 10% volume discount from 100.00

text.description:
## Summary
Order pricing computes the line totals, the subtotal and a volume discount before VAT.

## User story
As a shop manager, I want orders of 100.00 or more to get a 10% discount so that large orders are rewarded.

## Context
Prices are net euros with two decimals. VAT is handled elsewhere and is out of scope here.

## Out of scope
VAT, currencies other than euro, coupons.

## Environment
env: staging
text.acField:
Scenario: line total
Given a line with unit price 4.50 and quantity 3
When the line total is computed
Then the line total is 13.50

Scenario: order below the discount threshold
Given an order with the lines 4.50 x 3 and 20.00 x 2
When the order total is computed
Then the discount is 0.00
And the order total is 53.50

Scenario: order just below the discount threshold
Given an order with the line 33.33 x 3
When the order total is computed
Then the discount is 0.00
And the order total is 99.99

Scenario: order exactly at the discount threshold
Given an order with the line 25.00 x 4
When the order total is computed
Then the discount is 10.00
And the order total is 90.00

Scenario: order above the discount threshold
Given an order with the lines 60.00 x 1 and 12.50 x 4
When the order total is computed
Then the subtotal is 110.00
And the discount is 11.00
And the order total is 99.00

Scenario: quantity of zero
Given a line with unit price 4.50 and quantity 0
When the line total is computed
Then it fails with "quantity must be a whole number of 1 or more, not 0"
